If I understand this correctly, I should be able to get pass the ID maps and call `reconstruct_n` directly on the Index, which I assume still uses incremental IDs starting at 0.

I'm aware that I can always loop through the IDs and call `reconstruct` on each item, but I believe there must be a better way?
